name: effects-gradient-shadow-lower-third
exporter: Adobe Illustrator 2024 (28.5) - Export As > SVG, Styling: Internal CSS, Object IDs: Layer Names
story: A premium documentary lower third: a plate filled with a three-stop linear gradient, a radial-glow accent bar, and a soft drop shadow applied as Effect > SVG Filters > AI_Shadow_1, with three live text lines - name, role, programme strap - sitting on top.
idioms: Generator comment: 'Adobe Illustrator 28.5.0, SVG Export Plug-In . SVG Version: 6.00 Build 0)' with two trailing spaces
root attribute order version="1.1" id="Layer_1" xmlns xmlns:xlink x="0px" y="0px", viewBox on a continuation line indented with tab+space
<style type="text/css"> as a direct child of <svg>, never inside <defs>
.st0../.st11 single-property classes, several stacked on one element (class="st5 st8 st10 st11")
gradients auto-named SVGID_1_ / SVGID_2_ and emitted OUTSIDE <defs>, immediately before the shape that uses them
gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" with x1/y1/x2/y2 in artboard coordinates
<stop  offset="0" style="stop-color:#0D1017"/> - Illustrator's double space after the tag name, and stop colours in a style= string rather than stop-color attributes

the SVG-filter preset written verbatim as id="AI_Shadow_1" with filterUnits="objectBoundingBox" and percentage x/y/width/height, built from feGaussianBlur + feOffset + feFlood + feComposite + feMerge rather than a single feDropShadow
the filter reached through a class (.st0{filter:url(#AI_Shadow_1);}) on a wrapper <g>, not as a filter= attribute
the rounded rectangle emitted as a <path> with an arc-free 'M...h...c...v...z' outline, because Illustrator does not write rx
PostScript face names in quotes: font-family:'Archivo-Bold', font-family:'Inter-Medium'
unitless letter-spacing:2 in a class, font-size in px in its own class
tab indentation, one tab per nesting level
whyThisMatters: This is the 'will my design survive verbatim?' case: the gradients live outside <defs> under auto-generated SVGID_ names and the shadow is reached through a CSS class, so any importer that rewrites, re-serializes or namespaces ids - or that drops paint it does not understand - silently returns a flat grey banner with no shadow, which is the one thing the pixel-exact promise cannot afford, while the three lines on top must still bind.
